title: Financial Services (Retail Bank or Insurer) product catalogue, version 1
sourceDescription: Selected product evidence from current vendor pages, checked on 21 November 2026. Claims state what the vendor describes, not proven suitability for an organisation. Editorial review is pending. Coverage spans the sector’s main capability areas but is not exhaustive; a missing product is not evidence that no product exists.

entries.summary: A core banking platform for product configuration and account processing.

capabilities.name: Product Design & Management
capabilities.howItSupports: Configures banking products for launch and change

claims.statement: The vendor describes Temenos Core Banking as a core banking platform for product configuration and account processing.
The vendor describes Finastra Payments Hub as software for orchestrating payment processing.

entries.summary: Core policy administration software for insurers.

capabilities.name: Account & Policy Opening
capabilities.howItSupports: Administers opening and servicing insurance policies

claims.statement: The vendor describes Guidewire PolicyCenter as core policy administration software for insurers.

capabilities.name: Claims Intake & Assessment
capabilities.howItSupports: Supports claims intake, assessment and handling

claims.statement: The vendor describes Guidewire ClaimCenter as claims management software for insurers.
The vendor describes Entrust Identity Verification as digital identity verification software.

entries.summary: Software for detecting fraud in financial transactions.

capabilities.name: Fraud Detection & Prevention
capabilities.howItSupports: Detects and investigates potentially fraudulent transactions

claims.statement: The vendor describes Feedzai Transaction Fraud as software for detecting fraud in financial transactions.

entries.summary: Software for monitoring and investigating financial crime.

claims.statement: The vendor describes Feedzai Anti Money Laundering as software for monitoring and investigating financial crime.
